wx-alert-phone.action: View opens Melaton Weather on the alert (soft key); Dismiss clears it and the inbox copy
wx-alert-phone.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Weather: Alert / Weather: Severe alert (wmSounds per event: Play sound, Display message, Vibrate, Repeat)
wx-alert-phone.note: N1/N4/N5 ok: an alert for a place she configured (Home, Work, here). N6: the server's inbox copy wx:<alertId> has the same id and is only marked seen when this page shows its note (wmNotificationInbox.shownBy); the page's title carries the severity and the inbox's does not, so the title match could not dedupe it

wx-alert-balloon.area: Desktop weather alert tray balloon (weatherAlerts.js onIssued, PopoverManager popup id weather-alert)
wx-alert-balloon.action: a click opens Melaton Weather on the alert
wx-alert-balloon.switch: tray icon notification settings (trayRegistry popup 'weather-alert', trayPopupHidden) and the Weather Alert tray icon behaviour
wx-alert-balloon.note: N1/N4/N5 ok: an alert for a place she configured; one balloon per alert (shown set), one popup id so a second replaces the first (N9); no sound of its own

wx-rain-alarm.action: Weather soft key opens Melaton Weather; Dismiss clears it
wx-rain-alarm.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Weather: Rain alarm (wmSounds), and Melaton Weather settings for the alarm itself
wx-rain-alarm.note: N1/N4/N5 ok: an alarm she configured, once per rain spell; N6: same id rain:<place> as the server's copy, marked seen through wmNotificationInbox.shownBy

wm-chat-arrival.area: Melaton Mobile Dreamscape Messenger note (wmChat.js arrived / showSmsNote)
wm-chat-arrival.action: tap opens the conversation (or the list); Reply opens Quick Reply
wm-chat-arrival.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Dreamscape Messenger: New message (wmSounds chat: Play sound, Display message, Vibrate)
wm-chat-arrival.note: content she asked for (a persona's reply). N3: only when that chat is not on screen (viewing check in onStreamComplete / onMessageResponse). N6/N9: a reply landing within BURST_MS of the last sound while that note is up changes it in place, silently

wm-sms-arrival.area: Melaton Mobile text message note (wmChat.js tmOnMessage / tmShowNote)
wm-sms-arrival.action: tap opens the conversation; Reply opens Quick Reply
wm-sms-arrival.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Text Messaging: New text message (wmSounds sms)
wm-sms-arrival.note: delivery of the text itself. N3: not when that conversation is on screen. N6/N9: a text within BURST_MS of the last sound while the note is up changes it in place, silently; the app's native text notice posts instead when the page is behind

wm-chat-reply-open.area: Melaton Mobile open Dreamscape Messenger conversation (wmChat.js onStreamComplete / onMessageResponse)
wm-chat-reply-open.action: content: the reply is the line that just landed in the open conversation; no notice is raised
wm-chat-reply-open.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Dreamscape Messenger: New message (Play sound)
wm-chat-reply-open.note: N7 ok: the reply to her message arriving (the device's in-conversation message sound); sound only, no bubble

wm-chat-failure.area: Melaton Mobile Messenger / Text Messaging failures (wmChat.js failBox, stalled reply, message not sent)
wm-chat-failure.action: content: the failure text itself (a message box when it answers her tap)
wm-chat-failure.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Errors / Warnings (wmSounds)
wm-chat-failure.note: N10 ok: an error that stopped her message, told once in words; no second toast

wm-chat-quick-reply.area: Melaton Mobile Quick Reply dialog (wmChat.js quickReply)
wm-chat-quick-reply.action: she pressed Reply on a text / chat note: Send, View, Cancel
wm-chat-quick-reply.switch: none: asked for by her Reply key
wm-chat-quick-reply.note: not unsolicited: the dialog is the answer to her tap

wm-chat-confirm.area: Melaton Mobile Messenger destructive confirmations (wmChat.js delete / restart conversation, delete message)
wm-chat-confirm.action: Yes / No answer her own delete or restart tap
wm-chat-confirm.switch: none: asked for by her tap
wm-chat-confirm.note: a confirmation of a destructive action she just chose, not a notice

wm-settings-error.action: content: the failure of the Settings change she just made, in the Settings window
wm-settings-error.switch: none: failure of her own save
wm-settings-error.note: N10 ok: told once where it failed

wm-director-turn-sound.area: Melaton Mobile Director turn finished (wmShell.js directorTurnWatch)
wm-director-turn-sound.action: content: the Director's reply to her message; the sound is the whole notice (Display message off for the class)
wm-director-turn-sound.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Director: Turn finished (wmSounds director: Play sound; Display message on screen decides whether the server's notice shows instead)
wm-director-turn-sound.note: N7 ok: the reply to something she asked the Director. N3 / #1168 fixed: no sound while a page of hers shows that chat (status.watched, any client), as the server's notice rule says; a steered turn still sounds here (the page cannot tell it) - noted in the report

wm-note-sound.action: content: the sound belongs to a note that has its own click target
wm-note-sound.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications, one row per class (wmSounds ev[id]: Play sound, Repeat, Display message, Vibrate)
wm-note-sound.note: N7 ok for deliveries (mail, texts, Messenger, reminders, print failed, weather, Lapis, Traffic, questions); status / system notices (inbox classes system, api-key) are skipped here, and update, battery-full, info and question ship with Play sound off (N7, #1299)

wm-battery-low.area: Melaton Mobile Main Battery Low / Very Low note (wmShell.js batteryLowCheck)
wm-battery-low.action: Power soft key opens Settings > System > Power > Battery; Dismiss closes it
wm-battery-low.switch: Settings > System > Power > Battery (the warning level) and Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Battery: Main battery low / very low (wmSounds: Play sound, Display message)
wm-battery-low.note: N4 fixed (was no action). N6 ok: not a duplicate of DSApp DeviceNotices.kt CH_BATTERY, which posts only while the page is not in front (pageInFront), this note only while it is; a real warning of her data at risk, once per stage per discharge

wm-battery-full.area: Melaton Mobile Battery Fully Charged note (wmShell.js batteryFullCheck)
wm-battery-full.action: Power soft key opens Settings > System > Power > Battery; Dismiss closes it
wm-battery-full.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Battery: Fully charged (wmSounds: Display message on screen)
wm-battery-full.note: N4 fixed (was no action); N7 fixed: ships with Play sound off (a status). Kept as the call to unplug the charger, once per charge, and only while the page is in front (the app posts the same notice otherwise); whether it should default to Display message off is a decision for Yukimi

wm-nightshade-down.area: Melaton Mobile Nightshade Network unreachable at start-up (wmShell.js dcNotice)
wm-nightshade-down.action: Sign In (when the problem is the sign-in) or Retry the connection; Dismiss
wm-nightshade-down.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Connection disconnected (wmSounds: Display message on screen); sound off by default
wm-nightshade-down.note: N4 fixed (was no action), N9 fixed (a dismissed note is not raised again until the connection has been back). Only when the phone comes up and never reaches the server (DC_NOTICE_MS after Today), never on a plain disconnect

wm-text-signin-lost.area: Melaton Mobile Text messages stopped, page copy (wmShell.js smsNewWire signin_lost)
wm-text-signin-lost.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Errors / Warnings (wmSounds); the server's inbox copy has the Other notifications switch
wm-text-signin-lost.note: N6 fixed (duplicate): the server's inbox notice tm-signin:<account> says the same with View -> Messaging, so the page copy is raised only where the inbox cannot carry it (not an admin page, or no server link), and then has a destination

wm-alert-box.action: content: the alert text itself, a message box in the program in front with OK
wm-alert-box.note: N4 / N10 fixed: a bare alert() with no source became a warning note that stayed in the title bar without an action when it did not answer a tap; it is now always a message box titled by the calling program, one at a time

wm-package-restart-ask.area: Melaton Mobile screen-density pictures need a restart (wmShell.js packagesAdded confirmLarge)
wm-package-restart-ask.note: a question after a display change, needs a decision: design-decisions says an update is never a dialog by itself, the update icon and notification carry it; changing it needs serviceWorkerManager.applyPackageChange

wm-user-question.area: Melaton Mobile confirmations of her own action (close a busy program, End all, Unlock the car)
wm-user-question.switch: none: asked for by her tap
wm-user-question.note: a question about the action she just took, not a notice; info / question boxes no longer beep by default

wm-user-failure.area: Melaton Mobile failures of her own action (program could not open, download, output route, car key, Today background)
wm-user-failure.action: content: the failure text, a message box in the place that failed
wm-user-failure.note: N10 ok: an error that stopped her action, told once in words

wm-ui-click-sound.area: Melaton Mobile click sounds (menu pop-up, volume step feedback, screen taps, hardware buttons: wmShell.js playSystemSound('menu'), volume beep, playClick)
wm-ui-click-sound.action: content: the click answers her tap, key or volume step
wm-ui-click-sound.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Sounds: Screen taps / Hardware buttons (off as shipped), Notifications > Menu pop-up (off as shipped); the volume bubble's Off / Vibrate
wm-ui-click-sound.note: N7 ok: a hardware click; none of them plays unless she turned it on or moved a volume slider

wm-nightshade-signin.area: Melaton Mobile Nightshade sign-in dialogs (wmShell.js nightshadeSignIn)
wm-nightshade-signin.switch: none: only asked for (the glyph's bubble, Settings > Connections > Nightshade)
wm-nightshade-signin.note: never a box by itself (the comment says so); the answer to her tap

wm-nightshade-unreachable.area: Melaton Mobile server unreachable box (wmShell.js domainUnreachable)
wm-nightshade-unreachable.note: N10 ok: raised only when a command or an app she used needs the server while it is out of reach; the connection coming back closes it

wm-toast-bridge.area: Melaton Mobile page toasts that answer a tap, shown as a message box (wmShell.js toastsToDialogs)
wm-toast-bridge.action: content: the toast text; success toasts are dropped, progress becomes the wait cursor
wm-toast-bridge.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Errors / Warnings (wmSounds)
wm-toast-bridge.note: the shell's bridge for page code that calls showGlassToast; each caller's own toast is the audited site. An info toast answering a tap still becomes a box here - see the report

wm-update-note.area: Melaton Mobile update icon's notification (wmShell.js showUpdateNote)
wm-update-note.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Software update (Display message on screen; sound off by default)
wm-update-note.note: N1 ok: never pops by itself (silent, shown only on a tap on the update icon, Today's Notification key or the app's popup)

wm-notice-api.area: Melaton Mobile notice plumbing (wmShell.js appNote / notify / confirmationNotice implementations, the exported appNote / notification / sounds.play / sounds.alarm)
wm-notice-api.action: content: not a notice by itself; every caller carries its own source id
wm-notice-api.note: the emit mechanism, not a source; the callers are audited

wm-sound-preview.area: Melaton Mobile Settings Play button and alarm sound (wmShell.js previewSound, sounds.alarm)
wm-sound-preview.action: content: Settings' Play / an alarm she set
wm-sound-preview.switch: Play is her tap; an alarm's own sound is Settings > Clock & Alarms
wm-sound-preview.note: N7 ok: a user action or an alarm she configured

wm-desktop-sound-map.area: Melaton Mobile desktop sound calls mapped to WM sounds (wmShell.js watchSystemSounds)
wm-desktop-sound-map.action: content: the desktop code's own sound for its event
wm-desktop-sound-map.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Errors / Warnings / New e-mail message (wmSounds)
wm-desktop-sound-map.note: only the events the phone has a class for (error, critical stop, warning, default beep, new mail)

wm-msgbox-beep.area: Melaton Mobile message box beep by icon (wmShell.js messageBox, confirmation dialog)
wm-msgbox-beep.action: content: the box is the message
wm-msgbox-beep.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Errors / Warnings / Information / Questions (wmSounds); Information and Questions ship with Play sound off (N7, #1299)
wm-msgbox-beep.note: N7 fixed: only an error or a warning box beeps as shipped; a box answering her own tap does not

wm-crash-notice.area: Melaton Mobile restart after a crash (wmShell.js showCrashNotice)
wm-crash-notice.action: content: what happened (hang, killed for memory, crash); OK
wm-crash-notice.note: N10 ok: an error that interrupted her work, told once (the app hands the notice over once and an old one is dropped). Judged kept; the text has no action, so whether it should be a silent inbox entry instead is a decision for Yukimi

inbox-stack.area: Melaton Mobile stacked inbox notice (wmNotificationInbox.js showStack: mail stack, Fleet stacks)
inbox-stack.action: a row opens that item; the body / View opens the list or the source app; Dismiss clears it everywhere
inbox-stack.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Messaging: New e-mail message (Play sound, Display message) for mail; Other notifications for Fleet's stacks
inbox-stack.note: N9 ok: a flood is ONE box changed in place; N6 ok: a silent update changes it with no pop and no sound, the server's alert flag is the only sound

inbox-reminder.area: Melaton Mobile calendar / task reminder (wmNotificationInbox.js showReminder)
inbox-reminder.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Reminders (wmSounds); the reminder itself is hers (Calendar / Tasks)
inbox-reminder.note: N1/N7 ok: a reminder she set, the one thing that must sound; stays until dismissed

inbox-note.area: Melaton Mobile server notice the page missed or no page app shows (wmNotificationInbox.js show)
inbox-note.action: View opens the source app, Dismiss / Menu (Hide, Snooze); the box is the notice
inbox-note.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications, one row per notice class (wmSounds: Play sound, Display message; system and API key status follow Other notifications and never sound); inbox_prefs tells the server which classes are quiet
inbox-note.note: N6 ok: one box per id (shownNotes), a notice a page app shows is only marked seen (producerShows / shownBy); N5 fixed: system and api-key notices are now covered by the Other notifications Display switch on the server too; N7: no sound for status classes
